BiblicalUsage: Neah is named once, as a boundary mark on the border of Zebulun's inheritance, where the line runs on from Gittah-hepher toward Rimmon. It sits on the line the surveyors drew when the land was divided by lot.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the marker towns matter, because God measured out the inheritance town by town and none of it was left vague.
